audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Cassiopeia at Level 1, Level 6 and 2+ items, but the prose on the same page says Level 1 is 'a genuine coin-flip', Level 6 'keeps this even rather than a free kill', and late 'Shen reclaims the lane'. Levels 4-5 and First item were marked Skill while the prose claims Cassiopeia owns both.
audit.why: Difficulty is the second key point and the chart is the first thing a player reads; it contradicted its own why-text in four of seven stages.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia / Shen in both layers, matching the existing why-text and the packet level chart.
sources: existing whys[] on the same entry

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere, and Shen's own spike (Stand United coming online at 6) was described only as 'global R'.
audit.why: Power spikes are a key point; 'punish it while it is on cooldown' is unusable without the number.
audit.corrected: Shadow Dash 18s at rank 1 falling to 10s maxed, Spirit's Refuge 16s at rank 1, Stand United 200/180/160 named and numbered in the cooldown breakdown and mid-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stand United is a channel and Petrifying Gaze hard-CCs — the page never said the stun cancels his ult. It also claimed the taunt makes 'your Twin Fangs auto the wrong target', which misdescribes a taunt, and used the non-existent name 'Twin Fangs'.
audit.why: Cancelling a 160-second global save is the single highest-value interaction in this matchup and it was absent. Point 4 is the most important point.
audit.corrected: Petrifying Gaze cancels Stand United mid-channel; Miasma grounds Shadow Dash; Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only and never the poison; taunt stops your casts rather than redirecting them. Real ability name is Twin Fang.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Twin Fangs' used in spikes[3] and mid.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name; Riot's name is Twin Fang.

edits.before: His point-and-click E taunt plus global R flip the matchup: he taunts you mid-combo so your Twin Fangs whiff, soaks your single-target DoT as a tank, and presses R to swing another lane while you stay squishy with no boots and no resistances.
edits.after: Shadow Dash plus a global R flip the matchup: the taunt stops your casts mid-combo, he soaks single-target DoT as a tank, and Stand United swings another lane on a 160s cooldown while you stay squishy with no boots and no resistances.

edits.before: Poke his bar down with Q DoT before every shove so he cannot all-in off Ki Barrier or roam with R off a healthy bar
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze cancels Stand United mid-channel — when he presses R to save a diving ally, stun him and the save dies

edits.before: Land E taunt onto you mid-combo so your Twin Fangs auto the wrong target and his Q-empowered hit trades back
edits.after: Land Shadow Dash onto you mid-combo so the taunt cuts your Twin Fang chain dead and his Q-empowered hit trades back

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your window: ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs while he just soaks poison and farms. His only gap-close is the E taunt-dash, so your W (Miasma) grounds it and you kite him forever on passive move speed while your DoT shreds him. The catch is he regenerates between trades behind Ki Barrier and his W zone blocks your auto-resets, so commit when his W is down, not into it. At 6 your Petrifying Gaze faces down his taunt all-in and stuns the engage — but respect that his real threat is leaving with global R, so keep him too low to roam.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your window: ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang casts while he just soaks poison and farms. His only gap-close is Shadow Dash, down 18s at rank 1, so Miasma grounds it and you kite him forever on passive move speed while your DoT shreds him. He regenerates between trades behind Ki Barrier, and Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only — never your poison — so step up the moment its 16s is spent. At 6 Petrifying Gaze stuns his taunt all-in and cancels Stand United, so keep him too low to roam.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. It governs your forward steps. - W Miasma spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, 10s maxed. Step forward the moment it is spent. - Spirit's Refuge is 16s and blocks attacks only, never poison. - W Miasma spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold R to cancel Stand United.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze online — the face-check stun flips every all-in: they engage, you R, they die in the E-spam.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze online — it stuns his Shadow Dash engage and cancels Stand United mid-channel, but he can still leave.
